global_automation_scripts_rules.description: Whenever a test step corresponds to multiple automation actions, you MUST split the step into sub-steps (e.g., 1a, 1b, etc.), each sub-step must map to one script line, and all sub-steps MUST be implemented in sequence. This ensures full coverage and explicit mapping for complex navigation and validation flows.
global_automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Any test step that maps to more than one automation script line, such as 'Install and Launch the HPX app.', 'Navigate to printer details screen.', and 'Navigate to 'Add Shortcuts' screen.'
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step maps to multiple automation script lines (one-to-many mapping) or requires intermediary/supporting steps for full execution.

THEN: Split the test step into sub-steps (e.g., 3a, 3b, 3c, etc.), each mapping to a single script line. All sub-steps must be executed in the defined order. For each sub-step, include all intermediary steps as described in the mapping.

IMPLEMENTATION: Step Breakdown Example: Step 3 → 3a → self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False) [Tap on the Shortcuts tile from the printer details screen.], 3b → self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title() [Verify the Shortcuts screen title is displayed.], 3c → self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn() [Tap on the Add New Shortcut button.], 3d → self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title() [Verify the Add New Shortcut screen title is displayed.], 3e → self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut() [Tap on the Create Your Own Shortcut option.], 3f → self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title() [Verify the Add New Shortcut title is displayed.]. All intermediary steps must be implemented in sequence, and no steps may be skipped or merged.

global_automation_scripts_rules.description: Purpose-based/supporting step rule for implicit steps required for test execution or validation.
global_automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Any test case of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Email' destination shortcut.' where implicit/supporting steps are present in the correlation.
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Email' destination shortcut.'

THEN: You MUST include all implicit/supporting steps (e.g., 'Add supported printer on root view.', 'Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel.', 'Verify cancel confirmation popup title.') even if not explicitly mentioned in the manual test steps, as they are required for test case purpose validation.

IMPLEMENTATION: For 'Add supported printer on root view.', use 'self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn(), self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress), self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()' with intermediary steps: ['Click add device button','Search printer by IP address','Click printer device card']. For 'Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel.', use 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_edit_shortcuts_screen_title()' with intermediary step: ['Verify edit shortcuts screen title before cancel']. For 'Verify cancel confirmation popup title.', use 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title()' with intermediary step: ['Verify cancel confirmation popup title']. These steps are mandatory for fulfilling the test case purpose and must not be omitted.

global_automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-many mapping rule for splitting test steps into sub-steps for multiple automation actions.
global_automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps where a single manual step corresponds to multiple automation script lines (e.g., step 6, step 3, implicit add printer step, etc.).
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step corresponds to multiple automation actions.
THEN: You MUST split the step into sub-steps (e.g., 6a, 6b, 6c, etc.), each mapping to one script line, and implement all sub-steps in sequence.

IMPLEMENTATION: Step Breakdown: Step 6 → 6a → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.click_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn()', 6b → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title()', 6c → 'self.hpx_shortcuts.click_cancel_shortcut_yes_cancel_btn()'. Intermediary steps: ['Click cancel/go back button on shortcut popup','Verify cancel confirmation popup title','Click yes/cancel button on confirmation popup']. Execution order must be enforced and no steps skipped.

global_automation_scripts_rules.description: Rule for handling implicit/purpose-based/supporting steps required for test execution even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps.
global_automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Any test case of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Print' destination shortcut.' or similar.
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the cancel button of 'Print' destination shortcut.'

THEN: You MUST include all implicit/supporting steps such as 'Add supported printer on root view' and 'Ensure user is logged into the account', even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps, because they are required for test case purpose validation.

IMPLEMENTATION: For 'Add supported printer on root view', use 'self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn(), self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)' with intermediary steps 'Click the add device button on printer details' and 'Search for printer by IP address'. For 'Ensure user is logged into the account', use 'self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)' with intermediary step 'Load the home screen to ensure user is logged in'. These steps must be executed before proceeding to the main test steps to ensure the test environment is valid.
